candidates.name: Breast Abscess

a skin fistula developed with pus extruding and an “orange peel” appearance of the overlying skin
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results are consistent with a breast abscess.

an “orange peel” appearance of the overlying skin

candidates.name: Idiopathic Granulomatous Mastitis
support_spans: no history of tuberculosis or tuberculous contact
inflammatory markers and cultures were strictly normal
candidates.why: The patient's lack of exposure to tuberculosis and normal inflammatory markers suggest an idiopathic granulomatous process.
